Help.title: How can we help?
Help.subtitle: Find quick answers or reach us directly.
Help.chatToastDesc: Live chat will be available very soon.
Help.faq1A: The DC-3 is the Skills and Competencies Certificate issued by STPS. It's the official document confirming that a worker received training in line with the applicable Mexican Official Standard (NOM). At PROCHECK Solutions, when you pass the final exam with 90% or higher, our external training agent issues the certificate with a unique folio, signs it, and registers it with STPS.
Help.faq2Q: How long until I receive my certificate?
Help.faq2A: We issue the DC-3 certificate within 24 hours of passing the final exam. You'll receive it by email, and it will be available for download from your user dashboard.
Help.faq3Q: How long is my DC-3 valid?
Help.faq3A: Standard validity is 12 months for most applicable NOM standards. We send automatic recertification reminders 30, 15, and 1 day before expiration so you can renew without disruption.
Help.faq4Q: Can I retake the exam if I fail?
Help.faq4A: Yes. You have 3 attempts per exam, with a 24-hour wait between attempts so you can review the material.
Help.faq5Q: How do I pay for courses?
Help.faq5A: We accept credit and debit cards, cash payments through OXXO, and SPEI transfers. The CFDI invoice is issued automatically once payment is confirmed.
Help.faq6A: Yes. Every course includes HD video narrated by specialists, downloadable supporting materials, interactive assessments, and the DC-3 certificate on passing.
Help.faq7Q: How do I add my team?
Help.faq7A: As Client Admin you can go to /dashboard/team and use the 'Add member' button to invite your colleagues. Full team management documentation is available in that same section.
Help.faq8A: Yes. We coordinate in-person sessions with certified trainers. Book a call at /agendar to review scope, locations, and schedule.

Privacy.title: Privacy Notice.
Privacy.s1Body: PROCHECK Solutions, with address in Mexico City, is responsible for processing your personal data. For any questions, please write to the email listed at the end of this document.
Privacy.s2Intro: To operate the platform we may collect and process the following categories of personal data:
Privacy.s2Item11: Payment method metadata (we do not store full card numbers).
Privacy.s3PrimaryBody: delivering online training, issuing DC-3 certificates, tracking regulatory compliance, and invoicing services via CFDI.
Privacy.s3SecondaryBody: improving the platform, generating aggregated and anonymous analytics, and sharing product updates. You may opt out of these purposes without affecting the core service.
Privacy.s4Intro: We may transfer your personal data to the following third parties solely for the purposes described:
Privacy.s4Item1: Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social (STPS) for DC-3 certificate registration.
Privacy.s4Item2: Servicio de Administración Tributaria (SAT) for CFDI issuance.
Privacy.s4Item3: Payment processors (Conekta or Mercado Pago, once a provider is selected) to handle payments.
Privacy.s4Item4: Hosting provider for secure data storage.
Privacy.s4Note: Your personal data is never sold to third parties under any circumstances.
Privacy.s5Body1: You have the right to Access, Rectify, Cancel, or Object to the processing of your personal data, and to revoke any consent granted. To exercise any of these rights, send a request to
Privacy.s5Body2: with your name, contact method, and the action you want to take. We will respond within the timeframes required by the LFPDPPP.
Privacy.s6Title: 6. Use of cookies and similar technologies
Privacy.s6Body: We use session cookies to keep you signed in, local storage (localStorage) to preserve your cart and course progress, and analytics cookies to understand platform usage in aggregate. On your first visit we show a cookie notice so you can review and accept this use.
Privacy.s7Body: This Privacy Notice may be updated to reflect legal, operational, or service changes. When there is a material change we will notify you by email and publish the current version on this page with its update date.
Privacy.s8Body1: If you believe your rights have not been properly addressed, you may file a complaint with the National Institute for Transparency, Access to Information and Personal Data Protection (INAI). More information at
